data.body:
[P1] Rearm real timers after advancing the fake clock

The real timer is armed before `advance()` changes the clock, and neither `applyDeadline()` nor invocation startup recalculates it. With parallel waits of one hour and one hour plus one second, completing the first leaves a timer scheduled for approximately one real hour. If that branch resumes into a step awaiting the second branch, the second wait remains STARTED past its deadline and the test stalls. Recompute remaining timer delays after every shared-clock jump for all affected runners. Add coverage where a resumed step overlaps a previously scheduled wait or retry.
